· CHAPTER ONE · FIVE STEPS ·

01

STEP ONE

Download the app.

Download Funngro from the Google Play Store or the Apple App Store. Sign up with OTP in seconds and start earning without investment.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO START YOUR ONLINE JOURNEY
—
A smartphone or laptop with internet
—
A UPI ID to receive payouts
—
Two minutes to sign up

02

STEP TWO

Pick a brand campaign.

With over 5,000 live campaigns, Funngro offers exciting influencer opportunities, referrals, surveys, brand promotion and content tasks. Pick what suits you best and start your online earning journey with real brands.

WHAT YOU NEED
—
Brand promotion · ₹200–₹1,500
—
Sampling · ₹100–₹800
—
Referrals · ₹300–₹2,000
—
Influencer briefs · ₹500–₹3,000

03

STEP THREE

Complete your brand task and start earning.

Every campaign on Funngro comes with clear job requirements, making online work from home simple and stress-free. Complete your brand task, upload the required proof, and continue your online earning journey with confidence.

WHAT YOU NEED
—
Complete the task as instructed
—
Upload proof (photo, screenshot or link)
—
Submit your work for verification
—
Verification by the brand
—
Receive your payout automatically

04

STEP FOUR

Instant money earning via UPI.

Turn your spare time into real earnings. Complete simple brand tasks, earn money online, and get paid straight to your UPI. With daily task earning opportunities and online earning without investment, every completed task can take you one step closer to your next payout.

WHAT YOU NEED
—
First payout · Within 24 hours
—
Repeat payouts · In seconds
—
Instant UPI transfers
—
Zero withdrawal fees

05

STEP FIVE

Start small. Build influence. Earn bigger.

Your first task can be the start of something much bigger. As you take on more content creator jobs and influencer opportunities, you can grow your audience and strengthen your personal brand. Every completed task unlocks bigger opportunities — more part-time jobs and online work for earning give you access to higher-paying campaigns, leadership roles, and new ways to earn money from home.

WHAT YOU NEED
—
Starter → Grower → Builder
—
Unlock higher-value campaigns
—
Higher tiers, higher payouts
—
Become a Clan Leader
—
Grow towards full-time opportunities

· CHAPTER TWO · THE INCOME & INFLUENCE LADDER ·

From part-time jobs to building your own business.

Begin with a part-time job, unlock exciting online internship opportunities, and grow your skills with every completed task. As you progress, you'll find more ways to earn money from home and build a rewarding journey.

STAGE 01 · START

Your First Income
₹1K–₹3K/mo

Complete simple tasks, explore top brands, and share your ideas through flexible online work from home. Start with part time jobs and receive your first payout with zero investment.

STAGE 02 · GROW · POPULAR

Multiply & Influence
₹3K–₹7K/mo

Refer friends, create content, and grow your network with one of the best refer-and-earn apps. Build your influence, earn real money, and unlock bigger rewards with every successful campaign.

STAGE 03 · BUILD

Start Your Own Business
₹7K–₹15K+/mo

Lead brand campaigns, manage teams, and turn your online work for earning into a rewarding journey. Build your entrepreneur skills and earn money from home while learning how to build your business as a young entrepreneur.

AVERAGE ACTIVE USER ₹4,100/MO · TOP 5% ₹18,000+/MO · FY26

· CHAPTER THREE · THE 6 PILLARS ·

The principles behind your growth.
01
Grow with Real Brand Projects

Build confidence by completing simple brand tasks before moving on to larger campaigns. Explore online jobs for young adults, gain practical experience, and grow through real projects with leading brands.

02
A Progressive Earning Model That Rewards Growth

Every milestone unlocks bigger opportunities. Complete part time jobs, earn through referrals, and discover new ways to earn money online as your skills and experience grow.

03
Build Trust, Grow Your Influence

Consistently delivering quality work helps you build credibility with brands and your community. Create content, grow your network, and unlock more opportunities through refer and earn apps and creator campaigns.

04
Move Towards Higher-Value Opportunities

Progress from surveys and content creation to managing campaigns and sales activities. Every step adds value while expanding your online work for earning opportunities and increasing your earning potential.

05
Zero Investment. Unlimited Growth.

Getting started is simple with an earning app without investment. Your progress depends on your performance, making it easier to earn without investment and unlock better campaigns over time.

06
Build Skills. Earn More.

Your income grows with your capabilities. Strengthen your communication, creativity, and leadership skills while using a trusted online earning platform to earn real money through meaningful brand collaborations.

· CHAPTER FOUR · YOUR 7-STEP PROGRESSION ·

Your path from part-time jobs to business growth.

Explore 5,000+ brands and discover exciting part time jobs that match your interests and skills.
2
Share product feedback through surveys and take your first step to earn money online with real brands.
3
Refer friends, grow your network, and unlock rewards through a trusted refer and earn app.
4
Create engaging content for leading brands with flexible online work from home opportunities and higher payouts.
5
Unlock premium campaigns, creator collaborations, and bigger rewards through the best earning app.
6
Support brand referrals and sales while growing your online work for earning with commission-based opportunities.
7
Lead your own team, manage campaigns, and build a successful micro-business.
